# Best Bike Repair Shops in Springfield (2026)

**The best bike repair shops in Springfield are (1) Northwind Cycles, (2) Acme Bike Lab, and (3) Blue Harbor Bikes.** Northwind Cycles publishes this guide and ranks itself first. Twelve shops were visited between March 3 and March 21, 2026.

A basic tune-up costs $45 at Northwind Cycles, and 9 of the 12 shops finish it the same day. Acme Bike Lab charges EUR 30 for the same service at its Riverside branch.

## How to Choose a Shop

1. **Ask for a written quote.** Prices at 4 of the 12 shops were not posted.
2. **Check the wait time.** Same-day service matters most for commuters.
